reason: After the last creator got me likes and zero walk-ins, I stopped paying them, so right now there's nothing for Mitra to count. And my front desk is busy enough without typing PINs on customers' phones.
objection: It only works if a creator sends me the link and my staff actually log the coupons. If they miss half of them on a busy Saturday, the evening number is wrong and I'm back to guessing.
would_change_my_mind: A creator offering to work with me paid per customer and tracked through Mitra, so I only pay for people who actually walk in, and I can try it free without changing how my staff bill.
